title: Settings: account-protection fixes and a hash-addressed settings document
summary: Ends editor tokens on password change and deletion, requires the authenticator for destructive actions when one exists, fixes the step-up dialog and no-method dead ends, makes notification preference saves merge-only under a row lock, keeps error states honest (no defaults saved over real settings), adds a deletion preflight and manual-token step-up, and turns the Settings nav into hash anchors with observers.
concurrencyRisk: Notification preference saves lock the profile row and write only the changed top-level keys, so two tabs or a tray mute can no longer overwrite each other. Editor token revocation is a single UPDATE and idempotent.

rollback.strategy: Revert the commit. No migration is involved: revoked tokens stay revoked (the person signs the editor in again), and saved preferences keep their shape.
